tasks.objective: Define the minimum neural-native state and transition representation for a WANGA research process.
acceptance_checks: State, transition and provenance are explicitly represented
No dependence on an LLM vendor

tasks.objective: Specify reproducible behavioral evaluation boundaries for neural research components.
acceptance_checks: Negative and inconclusive results are retained

tasks.objective: Extract the candidate computational operations needed to reconstruct attribution and temporal position before contradiction detection: identity resolution, transmission tracking, attribution resolution, position/state tracking, temporal ordering, textual occurrence linking, and collision preparation.
acceptance_checks: Operations are derived from matrix cases rather than invented
Each operation declares inputs, outputs and uncertainty

tasks.objective: Build a perturbation test design for the C1/C2 representation: alter attribution, transmission, time or textual location one variable at a time and record whether the reconstructed collision changes.
acceptance_checks: Expected invariant and changed relations are separated
No accuracy percentage is claimed before testing
